Inside the roll · Macro cross-section

Proof in every bite

1 · The Snug Roll
Paper-thin layers, zero gummy dough

Look straight through the cut: a tight pastry spiral rolled snug enough to crisp all the way through to the core, so every bite shatters cleanly.

2 · The Clean Seal
Pure savory center, locked tight

Garlic-forward seasoned chicken filling sealed bone-dry. The outer shell stays blistered and crisp while the savory meat center stays tender and juicy.

The Fry Protocol · 350°F / 175°C

The 3½-minute fry.
Shatter-crisp every time.

Sold raw and flash-frozen the day they are rolled. Never thaw — drop frozen pieces directly into neutral oil at 350°F so the wrapper tension severs instantly on contact, puffing into millions of golden, micro-thin blisters.
